title: Bigger of two
prompt: Return whichever of a and b is bigger, using if and else rather than max(). bigger_of_two(3, 7) is 7.
hints: Compare them; return one in the if branch and the other in the else branch.
`if a > b:` return a, `else:` return b.

docs.name: if condition:
docs.what: Runs the indented lines below it only when the condition is true. elif and else add more branches.
Comparisons. Each gives true or false.
